title: Interaction Overview Tour
description: Create and edit interaction records including meetings, calls, emails, and other communications with partners and contacts. Supports AI transcription and file attachments.

popover.title: Welcome to InteractionModalComponent
popover.description: This modal allows users to create new interaction records or edit existing ones. It supports various types of communications like meetings, calls, and emails. Key features include adding participants, uploading relevant documents, and leveraging AI for transcribing and extracting details from audio or image files.

popover.title: Delete
popover.description:
Permanently deletes an interaction record after a confirmation dialog. Use this with caution as deleted interactions cannot be recovered.

When to use: When an interaction was recorded incorrectly or is no longer relevant (use with caution).

popover.title: Save | Create Interaction
popover.description:
Saves or creates an interaction record with all form data, including participants, documents, and interaction details. This action finalizes the interaction entry.

When to use: When all required fields are filled and you want to save the interaction to the system.

popover.title: Process Transcription
popover.description:
Processes AI transcription results from uploaded audio, image, or text files and automatically fills relevant form fields with extracted interaction data, such as subject, participants, or notes.

When to use: After uploading audio, image

popover.title: Tour Complete!
popover.description: You've learned the key features of Interaction. You can always restart this tour from the help menu.
